channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Feds say man groomed 13-year-old to engage in self-harm online and lured her to L.A. motel for sex
item.description: Federal authorities believe the suspect to be associated with nihilistic violent extremist ideology, which prosecutor Bill Essayli called "a growing threat to American families" and "one of the most twisted and disturbing ideas to crawl out of the Internet."

item.title: Two more skiers die in the Lake Tahoe area
item.description: Two more deaths added to the toll of a week that included the most deadly avalanche in modern California history. These unrelated deaths were at the Heavenly resort.

item.title: Buyer for Oceanwide Plaza's infamous graffitied towers emerges
item.description: The proposed buyer of the L.A. project in bankruptcy proceedings is a partnership led Kali P. Chaudhuri, whose firm owns properties in California and India.

item.title: Dramatic satellite photos show California’s mountains blanketed in snow after intense storms
item.description: See the images from space: After stormy weather, the Sierra Nevada mountains are covered in snow, and statewide snowpack levels are approaching normal.

item.title: Dozens of Mexican soldiers killed in cartel attacks after operation targeting drug kingpin 'El Mencho'
item.description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum seeks to quell fears after violence erupted in 20 states after the killing of the world’s most wanted cartel kingpin.

item.title: 'El Mencho': From California drug dealer to cartel kingpin
item.description: The founder of the ruthless Jalisco New Generation Cartel was killed Sunday in Mexico, authorities said, ending a criminal career that reshaped his country's underworld after humble beginnings on the streets of San Francisco.

item.title: Californians 'hunkering down' in Puerto Vallarta as cartel violence frays nerves
item.description: U.S. tourists and expats across Mexico sheltered in place on Sunday as cartel violence engulfed several beach resort towns after Mexican security forces killed Nemesio “El Mencho” Oseguera Cervantes, Mexico’s most-wanted drug trafficker.

item.title: Politics take center stage as Paramount submits new offer for Warner Bros. Discovery
item.description: Over the weekend, President Trump threatened Netflix, telling the streamer to fire Susan Rice from its board or "pay the consequences."

item.title: These are L.A.'s worst intersections. Why some might surprise you
item.description: What are the worst intersections in L.A.? We crunched the numbers and this is what we came up with. Some of the crossings will surprise you.

item.title: Newsom pushes back on 'fake' outrage and racism allegations from the right
item.description: During a stop in Atlanta on his book tour, Gov. Gavin Newsom of California talked about his 960 SAT score in attempt to appear relatable. Conservatives accused him of disparaging Black Americans.
